text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Civil Aviation (Carriage of Liquids, Aerosols and Gels) Regulations.

heading.en: Prohibition of carriage of liquids, aerosols or gels

text.en:
(1) The carriage by air by any person in hand-luggage on an international flight of any liquid, aerosol or gel to which these Regulations apply is prohibited. 6 CAP. 290, Rg 2 Civil Aviation

(2) Any such liquid, aerosol or gel carried or attempted to be carried in contravention of sub-regulation (1) may be seized by any police officer and shall be liable to forfeiture.

(3) Any person who contravenes or who attempts to contravene sub-regulation (1) is guilty of an offence and liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $10,000, imprisonment for a term not exceeding 6 months or both.
The Minister may exempt from the provisions of these Regulations any aircraft or person or classes of aircraft or persons. Authorisation of Director
The Director is hereby authorised to make and issue directions with respect to the carriage by air of any liquid, aerosol or gel on an international flight.
